scope: US view. Counts as each ad library reports them, not spend. First multi-platform pass.
headline: Bambu Lab is not missing from advertising, only from LinkedIn: about 3K ads on Google and about 350 on Meta, sold through retailers and creators.
so_what: LinkedIn shows only part of the picture. For Bambu, Google and Meta show who they are going after: consumer and prosumer buyers, which fits their defense ban. On a call, a Bambu machine in a defense account came from retail channels, not a B2B sales push.

LinkedIn.detail: live instances (34 on Oct 12). All 24 extracted.

Google.detail: hp.com shows about 50K worldwide, mixed with consumer HP. Do not cite as AM.

Meta.detail: No ads under the AM names searched. Not found in search, which is not proof of none.

rows.read: LinkedIn is its only measurable channel, and volume is down from 34.

LinkedIn.detail: live instances, 9 unique creatives (27 on Oct 12). Control passed.

Google.detail: US ads, 7 of them video. About 200 worldwide. One verified advertiser, Formlabs Inc.

Meta.detail: from its own page, plus reseller ads (MatterHackers 2). About 13 keyword results in total.

rows.read: The only competitor on all three channels. LinkedIn is shrinking while Google and Meta stay active.

LinkedIn.detail: a jobs ad only, no marketing creative.

Google.detail: US ads (36 worldwide). Verified advertiser 3D Systems Corporation.

Meta.detail: A keyword search returns 50,000 unrelated ads. Needs a page-level check.

rows.read: Quietest of the four. Google is its main visible channel.

LinkedIn.detail: No results for the names Bambu Lab and BambuLab. Other names were zero on Oct 12.

Google.detail: About 3K worldwide, 29 US video ads. Advertiser is the legal entity 深圳拓竹科技有限公司 (Shenzhen Tuozhu). US count caps at about 200.

Meta.detail: US results. Page Bambu Lab 3D, plus Best Buy, Target, AliExpress and named creators.

rows.read: Heavy on Google and Meta, absent from LinkedIn. Consumer and retail, not B2B.

trend.title: LinkedIn live instances over time
trend.note: Same advertiser names each run. A fall can mean ad rotation, so wait for more points before calling it a trend.

takeaways: Bambu Lab advertises heavily outside LinkedIn: about 3K Google ads worldwide and about 350 on Meta in the US.
HP and Formlabs both cut LinkedIn volume since September (HP 36 to 24, Formlabs 33 to 13). [Inference] Could be rotation or a pullback.
Formlabs is the only competitor present on all three channels.
HP shows no Meta ads under the AM names searched. HP's Google total cannot be split from consumer HP.
3D Systems is the quietest: one LinkedIn jobs ad and 9 US Google ads.
method: LinkedIn: Ad Library advertiser search with the exact name; control (Formlabs) run first and returned a count.
Google: Ads Transparency Center, domain page, region US. Counts above about 200 show as ~200, so they cap. A domain page can include unrelated advertisers.
Meta: Ad Library keyword search, US, active ads. Keyword results mix in other advertisers, so ads are counted by advertiser page name. Meta results are discovery, not a spend measure.
Spend is not estimated on this view.
not_done: Meta page-level check for HP and 3D Systems.
Creative-level capture (headlines, formats, run dates) for Google and Meta.
Bambu LinkedIn names Bambu Lab US, Bambu Japan and Tuozhu were not re-checked this run.
EU-country disclosure pass for Formlabs and HP was not re-run.
